mapper.sql: WITH employee_base AS ( SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.organization_id, e.name AS employee_name, NVL(e.department, '미지정') AS department, NVL(e.position, '사원') AS position FROM t_employee e WHERE e.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND NVL(e.employment_status, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' ), monthly_employee_usage AS ( SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.department, e.position, NVL(SUM(u.usage_count), 0) AS usage_count, NVL(ROUND(SUM(u.travel_distance), 1), 0) AS travel_distance, NVL(ROUND(SUM(u.carbon_amount), 1), 0) AS carbon_amount FROM employee_base e LEFT JOIN t_employee_usage_stat u ON u.employee_id = e.employee_id AND u.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND u.usage_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.department, e.position ), ranked_employee_usage AS ( SELECT m.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.usage_count DESC, m.carbon_amount DESC, m.employee_id ASC) AS usage_rank, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_employee_count FROM monthly_employee_usage m )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(usage_count), 0) AS total_usage_count, NVL(ROUND(SUM(travel_distance), 1), 0) AS total_travel_distance, NVL(ROUND(SUM(carbon_amount), 1), 0) AS total_carbon_reduction, NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN usage_rank <= CEIL(total_employee_count * (#{rewardTargetPercent} / 100.0)) AND usage_count >= #{minimumMonthlyUsageCount} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS reward_target_employee_count FROM ranked_employee_usage

SELECT employee_id, employee_name, department, position, usage_count, travel_distance, carbon_amount AS carbon_reduction, CASE WHEN usage_rank <= CEIL(total_employee_count * (#{rewardTargetPercent} / 100.0)) AND usage_count >= #{minimumMonthlyUsageCount} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reward_target FROM ranked_employee_usage WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
